Wrong assumptions: (1) Q3 Data Center was set supply-bound at TSMC's total-company 3Q26 revenue +16.2% q/q (US$), which carries smartphones (+10%); TSMC's HPC platform grew +22% q/q in NT$ (~+20.5% US$) [src 144] and NVIDIA's Data Center +20.9%, so the proxy, not demand, was the error ($4.2B short; the demand side, 0.546 x capex = $113.3B, was $5.7B too high). (2) GM sat at the 74.0% guide midpoint on a +/-0.3 pt record; NVIDIA printed 74.9% non-GAAP (+0.9 pt, no stated cause). (3) The EPS bridge's non-operating +$0.029 assumed ~$2.0B a year of net interest; Q3 non-GAAP other income was $253M (~+$0.009). (4) Tax 16.5% vs ~17.0% non-GAAP (17.4% GAAP). (5) Edge on a past Q3/Q2 shape: 3.6% low (RTX Spark and DGX Spark launches). Opex was 2.1% low. Guide vs record: Q4 FY27 outlook $130.0B +/-3% (14 weeks, no China DC compute) after 7 of 7 first-guide beats (median +4.81%, Q3 +7.3%); GM 71-72%; GAAP opex ~$11.0B; FY27 tax 16-18%. What moved: Q4 FY27 rebuilt (Data Center $127.9B = Big-4 Q4 capex x capture fitted on the three reported FY27 quarters x 14/13; TSMC's HPC-implied supply $139.9B does not bind; total $136.7B, above the range); Q4 gm, opex and the tax rate sit on declared guide uses; FY28-29 opex re-start from Q4's 13-week level; FY29 dc_capture rebuilt 0.55 -> 0.487 (content x SemiAnalysis share drift; coordinator's carry-forward batch 1), about -10%; hs_capex CY2027-28 kept on the per-company capacity drivers, each company-year now argued from its own Q3 call (1,013.9 / 1,355.5, was 1,013.9 / 1,359.4; Meta CY2028 250.0 on Morgan Stanley's Meta bar because Meta gave no 2028 driver and 'more flexibility in '28' was an analyst's paraphrase; the outside-forecast middle tried earlier tonight was withdrawn and is sized only); growth term 0.9821 -> 0.9639; tax 17% and net interest $1.0B in the FCF path; net cash $21.1B, shares 24,186M at -1.21% a year. dc_mor and hs_self_funded reviewed, unchanged. Research target (12m) $231.51 -> $204.16 (-11.8%). Q3 FY27 10-Q not yet filed (EDGAR submissions list shows only the 8-K of 2026-11-17), so the Data Center / Edge split stays on the release's rounded figures, flagged for re-check. Logged news moves: none (data/driver_news.json does not exist yet). SemiAnalysis Nov 13 read-through: SA1/SA1b/SA2 (hs_capex), SA3/SA4/SA4b (dc_capture) and a gm deflation alternative sized and carded; it also feeds the booked FY29 share term (not stacked with SA3). News screen (news.json; deltas treated as screens, not inputs), CFO commentary Ex. 99.2 [src 149] (www.sec.gov 403 to the generic User-Agent; read via the MarketScreener full text): (1) supply commitments $390B (from $279B; FY27 rest $69B, FY28 $203B, FY29 $92B) TAKEN as a supply cross-check: they cover the build's Q4 cost of revenue 1.8x and FY28 1.3x, so supply does not cap the Q4 or FY28 demand builds; no driver moved, not sized (no level follows from it). (2) Guarantees up to $118.0B ($105.0B SB Energy/OpenAI Ohio, $3.5B neocloud, $9.5B power/systems; no payment to date) and neocloud commitments that take effect only if the neoclouds secure financing: SIZED as a new downside item customer_financing (financed labs, about a quarter of FY28 business per management via Trefis [src 150], at half in FY29 -10.7%, half in FY28-29 -13.2%, lost in FY29 -21.4%; guarantees called in full -0.6%), carded, none booked (no lapse or payment; dc_mor already acts on the non-self-funded 57%); Q3 Hyperscale 55.9% gives hs_self_funded 0.460, sized +0.3%, 0.43 held. (3) DSO 64 days (from 60) on extended terms with investment-grade customers: SIZED on fcf_conv (held at 64 on new revenue -0.2%; a further 4-day step in FY28 -0.2%), 20% intensity held; REJECTED as a change since the 9M actual already carries the build. The screen's Q3/Q4 deltas were not used (the actuals and the rebuilt Q4 replace them). Call transcript not on fool.com yet.
